# AGENTS.md

This repository is a TypeScript SDK generated by flowapi from `flowapi-sdk.yml` and the API description its `spec` names.

## Where things are

- `src/client.ts`: the client class and its options; `src/resources/`: a class per resource, a method per operation; `src/api.ts`: the types and each operation's request and response; `src/core/`: the runtime (sending, retries, errors, pagination, streams).
- `mock/`: the mock server the tests run against; `tests/api-resources/`: a test per resource.
- `README.md` and `api.md`: the package's documentation, every method in `api.md`.

## What is generated

Every file listed under `files` in `.flowapi/lock.json`, with the hash of what was written. Do not edit one: change `flowapi-sdk.yml` (or the description) and generate again:

```sh
npx -y @localix-ai/flowapi@0.2.0 config check flowapi-sdk.yml   # every issue at once
npx -y @localix-ai/flowapi@0.2.0 generate flowapi-sdk.yml --out .
```

A generated file changed by hand is a conflict: generate names it, stops and writes nothing. A file generated before and no longer generated is deleted, unless it was changed.

## Changing the SDK

| To change | Edit in `flowapi-sdk.yml` |
| --- | --- |
| A method's name, or which resource it is in | `resources.<resource>.methods` |
| An operation left out, with why | `skip` |
| The base URLs | `environments` |
| Retries, the timeout, the default pagination | `defaults` |
| How a list pages | `pagination`, and a method's `pagination` |
| The README's heading, first paragraph and examples | `readme.title`, `readme.intro`, `readme.headline_method`, `readme.pagination_method` |
| `package.json`'s description and keywords | `package.description`, `package.keywords` |

## What is yours

- `src/lib/` and `examples/`: generate writes a file there only while it is unchanged, and never overwrites one you changed.
- `CHANGELOG.md` and `.release-please-manifest.json`: written on the first generation, then the release tool's.
- Every file the lock does not list: generate never touches it.

## Commands

```sh
npm install       # TypeScript, the one development dependency
scripts/check     # everything: lint, build, the built types, the tests
scripts/build     # dist/esm and dist/cjs, then both loaded by the package's name
scripts/lint      # the types, no node: module in the client, the tests parsed
scripts/test      # node --test over tests/, against the mock server each file starts
scripts/mock      # the mock server on port 4010, for trying the client by hand
```

The mock (`mock/routes.mjs`) answers each operation with an example of its schema and refuses a request its operation would refuse: a wrong path or method, a missing parameter, a body of another media type. Set `TEST_API_BASE_URL` to run the tests against another server.

## Releases

release-please opens the release pull request: it raises `package.version` in `flowapi-sdk.yml` and `package.json` together, so the next generation prints the version released, and writes the release's entry in `CHANGELOG.md`. Publishing is a person's step.
